data.name: Search Knowledge Base
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches indexed API documentation for a query and source URL, returning matching knowledge-base content.
Use for: find rate-limit guidance, locate authentication docs, search endpoint references
Not supported: generating a knowledge base, uploading files, exporting OpenAPI

data.name: Generate Knowledge Base
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a knowledge base from supplied documentation input, enabling later search and generated API descriptions.
Use for: build a documentation index, ingest API reference content, create searchable knowledge
Not supported: searching existing content, streaming progress, deleting a knowledge base

data.name: [SSE] Generate Knowledge Base
data.evaluateGuide:
Generates a knowledge base from a documentation URL and streams progress or results through an event stream.
Use for: ingest documentation, monitor generation progress, build a searchable index
Not supported: direct document search, file uploads, OpenAPI export

data.name: Generate OpenAPI from knowledge base
data.evaluateGuide:
Generates an OpenAPI description from documentation indexed in a knowledge base, with optional AI processing.
Use for: create an OpenAPI description, convert API docs, export endpoint definitions
Not supported: knowledge-base creation, document uploads, live progress streaming

data.name: Upload a new file to your knowledge base
data.description: Use this request to use the API to upload a new file to your knowledge base's Files storage.
data.evaluateGuide:
Uploads a new file to the Files storage of a KnowledgeOwl knowledge base.
Use for: add a documentation file, upload reference content, store a new file
Not supported: searching files, editing file content, deleting a knowledge base

data.name: Search Documents
data.description:
Performs a search query against the SearchLy index and returns ranked results.
Documentation: https://searchly.pro/documentation/
Quick Start:
- Set {{baseUrl}} = https://app.searchly.pro
- Provide your API key in the X-API-Key header ({{apiKey}})
- POST a JSON body containing at minimum query.
Parameters Explained:
- query (required, string): Text to search for (e.g. "laptop").
- top_k (optional, integer): Number of top results to return. Default: 10.
- filters (optional, object): Field filters to narrow results. Example: { "post_type": "product" }.
- algorithm (optional, string): Search algorithm. Valid values: default, fuzzy, exact. Default: default.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid X-API-Key header. Ensure X-API-Key: {{apiKey}} is set.
- 400 Bad Request: Malformed JSON body or missing query. Validate JSON and include query.
- 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded. Back off and retry after a short delay.
- 500 Internal Server Error: Server-side issue — retry later and contact support if persistent.
Edge Cases:
- Very short queries (1-2 characters) may return many low-quality results or be filtered.
- Filters that reference non-indexed fields will return no results.
- When GPT correction is enabled and the initial search returns few/no results, the service may call the GPT correction endpoint internally (additional credit usage may apply).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- API key scoped per-account. Refer to your plan for request quotas and credit usage.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches a SearchLy index with a query and optional ranking, filtering, and result-count parameters.
Use for: find indexed documents, filter search results, retrieve ranked matches
Not supported: indexing documents, updating records, deleting an index

data.name: Delete Knowledge Base
data.description:
Soft deletes a knowledge base by setting its status to DELETED (soft delete). The KB data is retained but becomes inaccessible for normal operations.
Documentation: https://docs.bland.ai/api-v1/delete/knowledge-id
Quick Start:
- Provide authorization header
- DELETE /v1/knowledge/{knowledgebaseid}
Parameters Explained:
- knowledgeBaseId (path, required): ID of the knowledge base to delete
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing API key
- 404 Not Found: KB does not exist
Edge Cases:
- This is a soft delete; data is retained but marked as DELETED.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not specified.
data.evaluateGuide:
Soft-deletes a Bland AI knowledge base, retaining its data while making it unavailable for normal operations.
Use for: retire a knowledge base, mark a KB deleted, remove a KB from active use
Not supported: permanent erasure, metadata updates, content search

data.name: Update Knowledge Base
data.description:
Updates a knowledge base's name and/or description.
Documentation: https://docs.bland.ai/api-v1/put/knowledge-id
Quick Start:
- Provide authorization header
- PUT JSON to /v1/knowledge/{knowledgebaseid} with fields to update
Parameters Explained:
- knowledgeBaseId (path, required): KB ID to update
- name (string, optional): New name
- description (string, optional): New description (set to empty string or omit to remove)
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid JSON
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing API key
- 404 Not Found: KB id does not exist
Edge Cases:
- Partial updates are supported (send only name or only description).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not specified.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates the name or description of an existing Bland AI knowledge base, supporting partial metadata changes.
Use for: rename a knowledge base, change its description, clear KB metadata
Not supported: deleting a KB, uploading content, searching indexed data
